sql.query: SELECT "public"."match_raw"."matchId", "public"."match_raw"."timeline" FROM "public"."match_raw" WHERE ("public"."match_raw"."matchId" = $1 AND $4=$5) LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
SELECT "public"."match_raw"."matchId", "public"."match_raw"."summary" FROM "public"."match_raw" WHERE ("public"."match_raw"."matchId" = $1 AND $4=$5) LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
SELECT c.relname name,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::text bytes,pg_indexes_size(c.oid)::text "indexBytes" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace=n.oid WHERE n.nspnam

INSERT INTO match_processing ("matchId", priority, "traceId", "updatedAt")
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT ("matchId") DO UPDATE SET priority = G

SELECT "matchId" FROM match_processing WHERE "matchId" = $1
      AND status = $3 AND "leaseToken" = $2
      AND "leaseUntil" > clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE
